parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json;const dealId=input.deal_id??null,leadId=input.lead_id??null,propertyId=input.property_id??null;const transactionStatus=String(input.transaction_status??input.status??'').toLowerCase();const closingDate=input.closing_date??input.target_closing_date??null;const seller=input.seller??{};const buyer=input.buyer??{};const contacts=input.closing_contacts??{};const required=['title','attorney','funding','broker'];const missing=required.filter(k=>!(contacts[k]&&String(contacts[k]).trim()));const blockers=Array.isArray(input.blockers)?input.blockers:[];const identityOk=Boolean(dealId&&leadId&&propertyId);const partiesOk=Boolean((seller.name||input.seller_name)&&(buyer.name||input.buyer_name||input.assignee_name));const transactionReady=transactionStatus==='transaction_ready'||transactionStatus==='ready';let status='blocked',next='WF-126',human=true;if(!identityOk||!partiesOk||!closingDate||blockers.length){status='coordination_blocked';}else if(!transactionReady){status='transaction_not_ready';next='WF-271';}else if(missing.length){status='coordination_incomplete';next='WF-272';}else{status='coordination_ready';next='WF-273';}return[{json:{...input,workflow_id:'WF-272',workflow_name:'Transaction Readiness → Title / Attorney / Funding / Broker Closing Coordination Controller',status,next_workflow:next,human_review_required:human,identity_valid:identityOk,parties_valid:partiesOk,closing_date_valid:Boolean(closingDate),coordination:{ready:status==='coordination_ready',required_roles:required,missing_roles:missing,contacts,closing_date:closingDate,seller:seller.name||input.seller_name||null,buyer:buyer.name||input.buyer_name||input.assignee_name||null},crm_activity:{activity_type:'closing_coordination_readiness',workflow_id:'WF-272',status,next_workflow:next,human_review_required:human,missing_roles:missing}}}];
